baseline_checks.name: contact_page_reachable
baseline_checks.detail: TimeoutError: Page.wait_for_selector: Timeout 8000ms exceeded. | page_path_at_failure=/contact-us | visible_h1='Not Found'

proposal.root_cause: The homepage CTA #contact-link points to /contact-us, but the Flask app only defines the route /contact. Clicking the link lands on a 404 'Not Found' page, so form#contact-form never appears. The memory hint concerns a different bug (button type), and contact.html already has type="submit".
proposal.reason: Pointing the link at the existing /contact route makes the contact page reachable, so the form and #send render. app.py is read-only, so the link is fixed instead.

recalled.text: ProofLoop VERIFIED FIX (run 20261016-142901-010fc5). Failing check(s) contact_submit_thank_you with symptom: page_path_at_failure=/contact | visible_h1='Contact us'. Root cause: The Send button in contact.html has type="button", so clicking it never submits the form. The POST to /contact never happens, the success page with 'Thank you' is never rendered, and the test times out on /contact. Fix that worked: in fixture_site/templates/contact.html replace '<button id="send" type="button">' with '<button id="send" type="submit">'. Independently verified in a cloud browser: candidate 3/3 checks pas
